page.overview:
Who is Hamato Splinter?

Hamato Splinter is a mutant rat with white bushy eyebrows, black whiskers on his muzzle, a pink nose and tail, a nick in each ear, dark brown eyes, short fur, and a thin figure. He has four fingers on each hand and three toes on each foot and white claws. Unlike his other incarnations, this Splinter has gray fur instead of brown fur.

He also has a somewhat disheveled appearance, especially a small notch in each ear, this disheveled appearance can also be seen reflected in his clothing too, which consists of an a torn red-orange kimono with dark brown trim, as if to imply that he has gone through more hardship, or simply to match the tone of the series.

For the Lost Episodes his attire changes to a jinbaori with same color scheme as his kimono along with black sleeves and black pants, bandages around the wrists and shins, a kasa hat, and traditional Japanese wooden sandals.

In Fast Forward Splinter's attire changes to a more futuristic version of his kimono, using also an Enviropack (Waist) that helps him to breathe in the environment of 2105, Graviton Regulator (legs) to walk and move easily through the different zones with different gravities and wrist translator (bracelet) to talk with the inhabitants of the new York of the year 2105. And although it was only seen in the first episode, a medium gray fur was added on his torso.
